articles.title: India's light tank Zorawar may face delays of up to 2 years as Army demands enhanced protection
articles.summary: India's indigenously developed light battle tank, 'Zorawar,' faces an estimated two-year delay in induction. The postponement stems from a critical requirement to enhance its protection levels against enemy fire. This strategic decision prioritizes crew safety and survivability, ensuring the tank meets robust operational standards before deployment. The delay underscores a commitment to equipping armed forces with highly protected and effective military assets for future challenges.
